extensionDescription.message: Enhance YouTube Picture-in-Picture with better playback controls.

timeDisplayToggleAction.message: Switch between elapsed and remaining time

optionsPageDescription.message: Choose how the mini player controls behave while you watch.

optionsPlaybackDescription.message: Set how far the video moves and how much the volume changes with each action.

optionsSeekBackwardDescription.message: Used when you go back from the player or press Left Arrow.

optionsSeekForwardDescription.message: Used when you go forward from the player or press Right Arrow.

optionsVolumeStepDescription.message: How much the volume changes at a time with the wheel or Up/Down Arrow.

optionsControlsDescription.message: Choose whether controls get out of the way while the video is playing.

optionsAutoHideDescription.message: Controls reappear as soon as you move the mouse or use the keyboard.

optionsAutoHideDelayDescription.message: Time without interaction before the controls disappear.

optionsShortcutsDescription.message: Available while the mini player is focused.

optionsApplyNotice.message: Reload YouTube tabs that are already open to use the new settings.

optionsInvalidForm.message: Check the highlighted values before saving.

optionsSaved.message: Changes saved. Reload open YouTube tabs to use them.

optionsResetDone.message: Defaults restored. Reload open YouTube tabs to use them.

optionsSaveError.message: Unable to save changes. Try again.
